name: licensing-status
title: Licensing Status
description: Redistribution status for a text in the Library. Decision 8 of strategy-decisions.md: no global rule, decided per book.

values.label: Public Domain
values.description: Full text may be hosted and redistributed freely.

values.label: Licensed
values.description: Full text hosted under an explicit license arrangement (e.g. Raëlian corpus, Decision 4).

values.label: Fair-Use Excerpt
values.description: Excerpts under fair use, with citation. Typically ~10% or less of the work.

values.label: Metadata Only
values.description: Catalog entry and citation, but no body text. Default for any unknown-status non-public-domain non-Raëlian text.

values.label: Unknown
values.description: Licensing status has not yet been audited. Treat as metadata_only until reviewed.
